chunks: Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Luʾluʾī, from Yaḥyā ibn ʿAmr, from Dāwūd al-Raqqī, who said:

I said to Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, “Indeed, I have grown old and my bones have become frail, and I asked your father عليه السلام, and he informed me about you; so inform me who will be after you.” So he said, “This is Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام.”

key_terms.أَبَاكَ: your father, meaning the preceding Imam whom the questioner had consulted
key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā, identified as the next Imam
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى: Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā, referring here to Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام
key_terms.فَأَخْبِرْنِي: so inform me, a request for explicit clarification
key_terms.قَدْ كَبِرَتْ سِنِّي: my age has advanced, expressing old age and urgency
key_terms.مَنْ بَعْدَكَ: who is after you, referring to the successor in the Imamate

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام indicate Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام as the Imam after him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a direct designation of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام by Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام in response to a follower seeking clarity about the Imam after him. Its significance lies in affirming continuity of the Imamate through explicit identification by the preceding Imam.
